name: Address Bar
description: What Chrome fills in as you type, and changing it: remove a suggestion, put one first, add your own.
reads: Chrome's address bar shortcuts (what you typed and which suggestion you picked) and the addresses in its history you typed in by hand, in each profile; changes are written there once Chrome is closed, with a backup

settings.label: Browser folder
settings.hint: If empty, Chrome's own folder. Another Chromium browser works too, e.g. ~/Library/Application Support/BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser
